Uzbekistan

Not the number now fighting; ethnic Central Asians with Russian citizenship are left out

items.name: Belarus
items.tip:
Belarus
2,871 Belarusian citizens fighting on Russia’s side, as of 20 May 2026, of whom 440 were killed
A different count from contract signers, and older than the Central Asia figures
Also: Belarus alone signed 1,862 new contracts from January to September 2026 (LIGA.net, 19 Oct 2026), a newer and different count
Source: the Ukrainian side, as of 20 May 2026, via Nasha Niva
Ukrainian figures, not independently verified.

items.name: Africa, 37 countries combined
items.tip:
Africa, 37 countries combined
2,982 people recruited in total, of whom 486 are known to have been killed, to Aug 2026
One combined figure: no split by country is given, so it is a cumulative total and is not comparable with the January to September 2026 rings
Source: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry, via Ukrainska Pravda, 16 Aug 2026
Ukrainian figures, not independently verified.
